links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses to caregiver FAQs (FKRE, SMOG)
links.effect: Mean FKRE 43.2, 39.9, 36.7 and SMOG 9.99, 11.24, 12.46 for Meta, ChatGPT, Gemini; readability sub-optimal for all three chatbots.
links.quote: All the AICs performed well in terms of accuracy, moderately in completeness and reliability, and sub-optimally in readability.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, accuracy, completeness, and readability of three commercial LLMs responding to patient/caregiver FAQs regarding PNAM therapy without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
